name: Cathay Pacific Cargo
description: The 2015 Cathay brushwing scheme on the freighters with the older title: white, no windows, dark green fin with the white brushwing, a small green brushwing by the forward door and 'CATHAY PACIFIC CARGO' in dark-green serif capitals over the forward fuselage.

sources.note: Cathay Pacific's own release on the livery unveiled in November 2015 (brushwing and name enlarged, name moved above the windows, all-green tail).

logos.description: The brushwing: a white calligraphic wing like a chevron pointing forward, its upper arm a long brush stroke curving up to a fine tip at the top near the trailing edge with ragged dry-brush edges, its lower arm short and straight back to a point at the fin's root by the trailing edge. Faces forward on both sides.
A small green brushwing under the cockpit windows, ahead of the first door, pointing forward.

titles.style: Dark-green serif capitals (the Cathay house serif), regular weight, over the forward main deck.

notes: The 2015 passenger scheme with the 'CATHAY PACIFIC CARGO' title, still the commoner of the two freighter titles in late 2026 (2024-2026 photos: B-LJA, B-LJC, B-LJD, B-LJF, B-LJG, B-LJH, B-LJI, B-LJJ, B-LJL, B-LJM). Being replaced at repaints by 'CATHAY CARGO' (cargo). Measured on B-LJJ (747-8F, 2026-06-19). Re-checked 2026-11-15: the title's start and length agree with a second photo to within 0.01; heights left, since the 747's hump has no measured shape yet.
history: Cathay's freighters took the 2015 brushwing scheme with this title; superseded from June 2023 by the Cathay Cargo title.
